decision: OPERATOR POLICY DECISIONS (2026-06-11, the pre-lock design pass this plan required — verbatim policy): OPERATOR-LOCAL CONFIG: default is DECLARE missing/divergent config explicitly (never silent divergence); optionally COPY selected declared-safe local config on create (allowlist, opt-in); AVOID live symlinks for v1 unless a file is explicitly marked safe and non-secret (practically: no symlinks in v1).
